name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, runtime PID and logging directories, service enablement, and cleanup of selected replication-related settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a Python FastAPI application from Git, installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, creates a virtual environment and application database, and runs Uvicorn through systemd.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures nginx for three SSL virtual sites, publishes static content, generates development certificates, manages site configuration, and applies host security controls.
